kenya_partners: VendorZephyr reached out: they want a combined marketplace tile + HSM/KMS connector announcement. Requesting SAML SSO (SP-init, signed assertions), SCIM group push, and callout for HSM keywrap.
olga_sec: We can support SP-initiated signed assertions. Approve wording: 'HSM-backed key wrapping (FIPS-validated modules)'. Do not expose KMS endpoints.
mike_ops: SCIM group push is supported on Enterprise. I'll draft a mapping for groups 'data-science' and 'infra'. Also will add a PKCS#11 sample for HSMs.
sarah_marketing: Marketplace needs long description >=300 chars and two screenshots. Can we produce a sanitized onboarding GIF?
mike_ops: Yes, staging can produce a GIF showing SSO button and group sync success, redacted.
kenya_partners: Timeline: partner requests submission by 2028-04-15, embargo until 2028-04-29. Marketing wants assets by 2028-04-08.
marketplace_bot: Reminder: listing schema requires short_description (<=100 chars), long_description (>=300 chars), icons, and compliance badges for FIPS claims. See guide link.
olga_sec: I'll prepare a compliance blurb and a cert rotation snippet (60-day cadence, RSA-SHA256).
sarah_marketing: Draft tile copy suggestion: 'Redwood + VendorZephyr: secure inference with optional customer-managed HSM keywrap, SAML SSO and SCIM provisioning.' Keep it concise.
kenya_partners: I'll request a staging SP and test org from VendorZephyr today. Pulling this thread into a PR once assets exist. Flag blockers here.
